data.long_meaning: Janelle is a French name derived from the Hebrew Yehonah, meaning 'God is gracious'. In the Bible, the name Yehonah is borne by a Levite gatekeeper at the temple and by the wife of King Jehu. This name was also borne by a female character in the 19th-century French novel 'Claude et Janelle'. The name Janelle carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Janelle usually hope their child will grow to embody god is gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
